title: Revit governed level and grid alignment
test_intent: Determine whether Revit levels and grids match the approved project datum/grid source in identity and spatial position, without unexplained local offsets or competing datum systems.

applicability.applies_when: The tested Revit model contains governed levels or grids and an approved project datum/grid source applies.
applicability.not_applicable_when: The tested model contains no governed levels/grids or no datum/grid rule applies to its scope.

required_evidence: approved project level/grid source or coordination authority data
Revit level inventory including name and elevation
Revit grid inventory including identity and position/geometry

result_logic.pass: Every applicable tested level and grid matches the approved source within the governed identity/spatial rule and no unexplained duplicate, offset, or competing datum system is present.
result_logic.fail: An applicable level or grid positively conflicts with the approved governed source in identity or spatial position, or an unauthorized competing datum system is present.
result_logic.not_applicable: No governed level/grid rule applies to the tested model.
result_logic.indeterminate: The approved datum/grid source, coordinate transform, or comparison tolerance required for evaluation is unavailable or ambiguous.

provenance.migration_note: Appendix E ATS subordinate to S6 spatial authority. It does not promote source naming examples or invent spatial tolerances.
